micro_gaps.definition: expected 15m slot absent between a day's first and last valid bar (interior hole; >=1 non-tradable minute inside the slot). Market-closed slots outside a day's span are reported by span stats, not as gaps

day_span_slots.note: slot = minute-of-day // 15 over the 96-slot UTC grid

reconcile.method: per-bar s_open/pip medians recomputed from persisted bars15 parquet, bucketed per session, vs census p50
